p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing : standards, labels and health regulations, that the country sets for products.

p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN : Check the regulatory status of the platform before you invest.
p.espaces.rg_note: The site opens in your native language: use your browser's translation function or use "Learn about the document" for the document.
p.espaces.cu_d: Customs, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, freight forwarders and carriers.

p.espaces.cu_d3: Transport documents: Bill of Lading (sea), Air Waybill (air), CMR (road)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of Origin (to obtain duty relief)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (for companies importing and exporting in the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standard
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer handles everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the goods to the buyer's carrier after export customs clearance.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: The seller loads the goods on board the ship; the buyer bears the risk and cost thereafter.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller pays the freight and insurance to the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: The seller delivers the goods to the destination and the buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: The seller pays all costs, including import duties.

p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose products that are permitted in the country of the customer: no counterfeits, no unauthorized regulated products.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier (the "Wholesale/Supplier" list here or wholesale platform) and order samples before you sell.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculate the real price: product, shipping, customs, VAT in the country of the customer, payment costs and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Tell your customers the real delivery time.

p.espaces.ds_s6: Respecting consumer rights: clear prices, including taxes, returns, warranties, data protection.
